modeArchitecture.easy: Eight guided steps, phone and desktop
modeArchitecture.sharedModel: A single plan, common part ids and units; mode is only presentation
modeArchitecture.guest: Read-only version snapshot, never the working editor

serviceEnvelope: width + 2 * margin; depth + 2 * margin; illustrative editable supplier allowance
forecasts: Example data only. Future event dates use scenarios until forecast horizon is available. Forecast UI must distinguish issue time, valid time, location and uncertainty.
placeRegistration: Upload -> detect anchors -> manual confirm three points and known distance -> accept. No guessed map alignment automatically accepted. Base map stays locked.
share: Create immutable layout snapshot; changes require new shared version. Event time versus now are distinct.
export: Pro shows JSON, parts list, version snapshots. Production scoped PDF/CAD/georeferenced exports represented only.
eventTimezone: Derived from the real location and stored on the plan; all event-time sun/forecast views use it.
